title: 第18章 点亮甜品店
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
五十个纸箱子堆在地上，把进出的路都挡了。

    一些吃完饭回办公室的员工路过前台，看着一大堆箱子嚯了一声。

    “这是公司的福利还是部门的福利？”

    “才几十个箱子，不可能是公司，前几天我还听说市场部要购买员工周内福利，这不会就是吧？”

    有人认出了方涵，便问：“这是你们市场部的吗？”

    “是我的。”

    方涵确认了都是她的快递，便随便拆开一箱检验。

    纸箱子似乎是才出厂，还有些许纸屑味。

    但一打开，一大股浓烈的果香味便飘出，迅速压住纸盒子的味道。

    方涵拿出一个芒果撕开气泡膜，检查了一遍，确保真的是‘月亮牌’芒果。

    她笑嘻嘻地捧着芒果回头，“仪姐你看，我就说树姐姐一定会眷顾我，走了那么多次霉运，可算来好运了。”

    顾令仪没有看芒果，视线随着她的身体下移，落在被芒果带出、掉在地上的卡片上。

    “这是？”

    她蹲下捡起卡片，翻转一看，平静的眼眸微微一动，瞳孔悄然放大了一圈。

    “华夏？”

    顾令仪瞬间被卡片上的这两个字吸引，连精彩的漫画都没入眼。

    “...有服章之美，谓之华。”

    一道断断续续的声音响彻在顾令仪脑海，她一怔，连忙屏气凝神认真倾听。

    但思绪闪过太快，只来得及听到后半句。

    “有服章之美，谓之华....”

    华夏？华夏！

    顾令仪秀眉一蹙，谁在她脑子里说话？

    前半句呢，前半句是什么？

    “仪姐，你在看什么？快来看芒果，我就说我走了好运。”

    方涵捧着芒果来到顾令仪身边，看见卡片内容，目光倏地被吸引住。

    “小芒果是如何传入华夏？华夏是哪里？芒果不是阿三国的吗？”

    顾令仪回神，轻轻摇了下头，“不知道，你不觉得华夏这个名字很美妙吗？仿佛和花国很配。”

    “确实，朗朗上口，给我一种欧洲中古世纪的感觉。”

    方涵看了两眼就不感兴趣了，抬手将同部门的同事找来，让他们来帮忙搬水果。

    顾令仪拿着卡片抿了下嘴，按照快递单上的地址搜寻，很快在地图上找到幸福小镇。
content_en:
Fifty cardboard boxes were piled on the floor, blocking the way in and out.

    Some employees who were returning to the office after dinner passed by the front desk and looked at the pile of boxes and made a noise.

    "Is this a company benefit or a department benefit?"

    "There are only dozens of boxes. It can't be a company. I heard a few days ago that the marketing department wants to purchase employee benefits during the week. Isn't this the case?"

    Someone recognized Fang Han and asked, "Is this from your marketing department?"

    "It's mine."

    Fang Han confirmed that it was all her express delivery, and casually opened a box for inspection.

    The cardboard box seemed to have just left the factory, and it still had a slight confetti smell.

    But as soon as I opened it, a strong fruity aroma wafted out, quickly overpowering the smell of the cardboard box.

    Fang Han took out a mango and tore off the bubble wrap and checked it to make sure it was really a 'Moon Brand' mango.

    She looked back with a smile while holding the mango, "Sister Yi, look, I said Sister Shu will definitely take care of me. After so many bad lucks, this is good luck."

    Gu Lingyi didn't look at Mango. His eyes followed her body and landed on the card that Mango took out and fell to the ground.

    "This is it?"

    She knelt down to pick up the card, turned it over and looked at it. Her calm eyes moved slightly, and her pupils quietly dilated.

    "China?"

    Gu Lingyi was instantly attracted by the two words on the card and didn't even notice the wonderful cartoon.

    "...It has the beauty of serving as a seal, which is called splendor."

    An intermittent voice resounded in Gu Lingyi's mind. She was startled and quickly held her breath and listened carefully.

    But my thoughts flashed by too quickly, and I only had time to hear the second half of the sentence.

    "There is the beauty of the uniform, which is called the splendor..."

    China? China!

    Gu Lingyi frowned, who was talking in her head?

    What about the first half of the sentence? What is the first half of the sentence?

    "Sister Yi, what are you looking at? Come and see the mango, I'll tell you I'm lucky."

    Fang Han came to Gu Lingyi holding a mango. When he saw the content of the card, his eyes were suddenly attracted.

    "How did the little mango come to China? Where is China? Isn't the mango from the Asan Kingdom?"

    Gu Lingyi came back to his senses and shook his head slightly, "I don't know, don't you think the name Huaxia is wonderful? It seems to match the country of flowers."

    "Indeed, it's catchy and gives me a feeling of medieval Europe."

    Fang Han took a second look and lost interest. He raised his hand and called for his colleagues in the same department to help move the fruit.

    Gu Lingyi pursed her lips while holding the card, searched according to the address on the express delivery note, and quickly found Happy Town on the map.
title_en: Chapter 18 Light up the dessert shop
